text: Sankashti means 'the difficulty' — this day is traditionally observed to face challenges that feel stuck in your life.
With Lord Ganapati, who clears all obstacles, it's a day for starting, not for waiting.
Today, you are invited to chant 'Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha'.
You may offer దూర్వా గడ్డి (durva grass) and a little బెల్లం (jaggery) to Sri Ganapati.
If it suits your home, consider doing the evening pooja after moonrise.
Name one thing you have been putting off, and take the first small step on it today.
